scope_limit: Redefined means the published definition changed with the label: AHRQ renamed PSI 09 in v2021 (Perioperative to Postoperative) and CMS PSI software v12.0 modified its denominator exclusions (platelet disorders); AHRQ v2022 added a timing exclusion. Two identities split at the October 2022 Care Compare label change, the first release that carries the Postoperative name. The exact month CMS adopted software v12.0 is undocumented: QualityNet has no July or October 2022 row, so the split date is the first observed release with the new label, not a documented effective date. The identity does not certify numerical comparability across the split.
